# Gnarltusk

*A boar as tall as a cart, with tusks like ploughshares, has made the yard of Stilebrook Farm its wallow. When it lowers its head it is about to charge: get out of its line or over it. Old fence rails come down where the shadows show. Potions work in there; scrolls do not.*
